entry.name: Quynh Dang
entry.university: National Institute of Standards and Technology
entry.department: Cryptographic Technology Group, Computer Security Division, Information Technology Laboratory

evidence.currentRole: [NIST personal profile](https://www.nist.gov/people/quynh-dang) — "Computer Scientist"; identified as federal staff in the Cryptographic Technology Group.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: No doctorate claimed. Current-employer publications within 2023-11-17–2026-11-17: (1) Scott Fluhrer and Quynh Dang, Smaller Sphincs+, Cryptology ePrint 2024/018, received 2024-01-05 and revised 2025-01-16; explicitly identifies Dang's NIST affiliation and email: https://eprint.iacr.org/2024/018. (2) Additional Digital Signatures second-round research report, NIST IR 8610, May 2026; names Quynh Dang with NIST affiliation and ORCID 0009-0005-9801-6805; approved by NIST's Editorial Review Board on 2026-05-05: https://tsapps.nist.gov/publication/get_pdf.cfm?pub_id=962093. (3) Fourth-round post-quantum standardization research report, published 2025-03-11, also listed on the personal profile: https://www.nist.gov/publications/status-report-fourth-round-nist-post-quantum-cryptography-standardization-process. The latter two publications are NIST research reports.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given-name token Quynh accompanies Dang on the opened employer profile: https://www.nist.gov/people/quynh-dang. No diacritic name reconstructed.
evidence.location: [NIST IR 8610, page 2](https://tsapps.nist.gov/publication/get_pdf.cfm?pub_id=962093) — "NIST, Gaithersburg, Maryland, USA" in Quynh Dang's author affiliation, rather than the website's headquarters footer.
evidence.dedup: Searched public/data.json for Quynh Dang, Quynh H. Dang, name-order variants, and the profile URL. Ran npm run find-roster-matches for Quynh Dang and Quynh H. Dang, including the employer profile and linked ORCID URL: no roster or retired-ID matches. Checked maintenance/sector-expansion/already-proposed.txt, including reordered name tokens: no match. Did not attribute the unrelated optical-physics papers mixed into DBLP's Quynh Dang record to this researcher.
